finding.claim: The Inputs section says `version` takes "X.Y.Z with no v", but release.yml's version input also accepts a pre-release version X.Y.Z{a,b,rc}N. An operator who wants an exact pre-release version would think they cannot type one.

fixes.change: The version input now names the pre-release form X.Y.Z{a,b,rc}N beside X.Y.Z, as release.yml accepts.
